run_evaluate_deterministic: run deterministic evaluation on a model with a single pass and dropout turned off
run_evaluate_mc_with_geometric_mean: run MC dropout evaluation using geometric mean of predictions across multiple samples
run_evaluate_mc_with_power_mean: run MC dropout evaluation using power mean of predictions with configurable power parameter
run_evaluate_mc_with_arithmetic_mean: run MC dropout evaluation using arithmetic mean of predictions across multiple samples
run_evaluate_all: evaluate model on training, validation, and test sets with automatic temperature tuning
